findings.detail: An initialized submodule with a reviewed path such as module/src/file.go can have mandatory review instructions in its historical AGENTS.md. Guideline discovery queries module/AGENTS.md using the superproject's revision and object database. That tree contains a gitlink, not the child's files, so the guide is omitted. The rendered prompt also prohibits loading checkout instruction files, leaving the child's required review checks unapplied while the aspect can report success. Resolve historical guidance within each captured repository using the corresponding trusted child revision. The root-only lookup predates this change; recursive child review exposes the mismatch.
findings.evidence: render_scope recursively visits initialized child scopes at codex-aspects:447-454. In contrast, render_guides selects only the outer .base // .head at line 567 and passes that ref and the outer top_level to every historical_guide call at line 579. historical_guide queries that repository with ls-tree at line 539. No child-repository or child-revision resolution occurs. Lines 674-676 instruct reviewers to use the supplied historical guidance and avoid current checkout instructions.
findings.title: Parallel paths: recursive reviews omit historical submodule instructions
